verdict.rationale: Expensify documents SmartScan, which reads merchant, date, total and currency from a camera photo in real time and automatically matches the scanned receipt to the card transaction without manual matching or duplicates. Users corroborate that it scans receipts and enters the data, and that it reads amounts well. One user reported slow processing (about 20 minutes), but that limits speed rather than contradicting the capability. Missing for 10: documented email-forwarding receipt capture (only integration imports such as Uber are evidenced), independent corroboration of automatic transaction matching, consistent processing speed.
